Lollapalooza India 2027 Lineup Sparks Debate Over Indian Artist Inclusion

The announced lineup for Lollapalooza India 2027, scheduled to take place at Mumbai's Mahalaxmi Racecourse, has generated online discussion. Singer Benny Dayal voiced support for the inclusion of Indian artists, questioning the lineup's balance. The debate centers on the representation of domestic talent alongside international acts like Limp Bizkit and Olivia Dean.
